name: Adaptive IOR Optimization
definition: An algorithm that iteratively optimizes the Index of Refraction (IOR) during training by searching for the IOR that minimizes the MSE between rendered foreground and ground truth.
summary: Adaptive IOR Optimization is a training procedure for neural radiance fields that iteratively searches for the optimal Index of Refraction to minimize reconstruction error, distinguishing itself by treating IOR as a discrete search parameter rather than a continuous variable.
